name: Gurupur

sink.name: Gurupur estuary, near Tannirbhavi
sink.location: Mangalore, Dakshina Kannada district, Karnataka, Arabian Sea

significance: runs parallel to the Netravati, together forming Mangalore's twin-river backwater system
New Mangalore Port sits on its northern bank
did_you_know: The Gurupur and Netravati rise close together in the same stretch of the Western Ghats and share an interconnected estuary at Mangalore — grouped here under the Netravati basin rather than a separate one, since HydroRIVERS shows no clean catchment boundary between the two near the coast.
